Title: Intro

Rumors of mysterious disappearances have reached {playerPossessive} ears,

Title: Alley Ambush
Description: {playerName} is on {playerObject} nightly patrol. It's a calm and quiet night in Nightfall City.
Suddenly, a shadow twist and leaps from the walls—a thieve or worse.
{playerName} launches back at the attacker, and their punches echo through the alley.
{playerSubject} attacks from behind, gips {enemyPossessive} hood and barely pulls it off to reveal {enemyPossessive} face.
{enemySubject} reaches back over, grips {playerObject} collar and throws {playerObject} over {enemyPossessive} shoulder to the ground.
Looking back up at {enemyObject}, {playerSubject.ToLower()} notices something...
Peeking out fron under {playerPossessive} unknown opponents hood..
is some backcombed bleach blonde hair. Who is this "fancy" bastard?
{playerName}: "WTF, man! If you ruin my night let me at least return the favour."
